selection_method: Deterministic random sample fixed before CIRP answers were requested

questions.question: What are the project name, DOE job number, project address, and stated scope of work?
Which three work areas are listed in the required construction sequence, and how much construction time is assigned to each?
For Building G, what construction type, occupancy groups, story count, and sprinkler status are listed?
For Building I, what construction type, occupancy groups, story count, and sprinkler status are listed?
How many Volume I drawing sheets are listed for each discipline: General, Architectural, Structural, Mechanical, Fire Protection, and Plumbing?
On sheet A3.00, what materials are identified by wall substrate codes 1, 2, 21, and 22, and what is the default spacing for interior stud framing and furring?
On sheet A5.01, what are the general requirements for door thickness, door-handle type, and the side of the frame where relite glazing and stops occur?
On sheet A3.40, what do the general finish notes require for flooring transitions, door and relite frame paint, and gypsum-board ceiling paint?
In ASK 001.2 / RFI 016, how is the top of the full-height metal stud wall attached at the existing wide-flange beam, and what gypsum-board repair and acoustic-sealant requirements are shown?
On sheet M5.01, what support spacing is required for rectangular duct, and what hanger components or allowed substitute are shown for round duct?
Using the discipline sheet counts on the Volume I cover sheet, what is the total number of base drawing sheets? Show the arithmetic.
On sheet G2.10, add the printed Building G L1 and L2 occupant-load subtotals. What sum do they produce, and does it match the printed total?
Using Section 01100 paragraph 1.04, what is the total scheduled construction time for the three sequential work areas? Show the arithmetic and state the one-floor-at-a-time constraint.
Using Section 01100 paragraph 1.03, how many calendar days of the 589-day contract duration are outside the stated 367-day on-site duration? Show the arithmetic.
Section 00800 states liquidated damages of $2,000 per calendar day. What are the per-day amounts for punch-list delay at 10 percent and closing-document delay at 5 percent? Show the arithmetic.
